knowledge_gaps: The report omits directly relevant sequence-cropping and augmentation research. Originality 3 is plausible, but its justification needs closer precedents than future-supervision methods such as UFRec.

The baseline target-index distribution is unresolved. A dense-target sampler may have no equivalent single target-index distribution; choosing only its final target changes supervision density and target coverage. The proposed matched control isolates cropping within final-target training, but does not establish that this supervision change is necessary.

The negative-sampling pseudocode passes only the target. Preserve any baseline user-history exclusions and proposal distribution, including exclusions for events removed by cropping. Otherwise the intervention also changes negative sampling.

Reproducibility needs an explicit RNG API and separate deterministic augmentation stream so crop draws do not change user, target or negative draws between controls. Diagnostic comparisons should use identical uncropped histories, targets and negatives; separate cropped-input probes can measure sensitivity.

The augmentation may be weak: for n>5, the actual shortening probability is 0.25*(n-5)/(n-4), and expected events removed per row is (n-5)/8. Report these quantities by category and history length. Training on cropped histories while evaluating full histories also needs justification.

The evaluation plan omits paired validation uncertainty and adaptive-selection limitations. One changed hit changes macro HR@10 by 0.00125. Potential 6 and difficulty 3 are reasonable provisional judgments, but neither benchmark benefit nor integration effort has been established.
